aboutSectionSubtitle: Dedicated to excellence in institutional communication and community engagement
aboutMission: The Strategic Communications Office serves as the primary hub for institutional communication at De La Salle University-Dasmariñas. We identify the diverse information needs of different offices within our academic community and develop comprehensive communication strategies to meet those needs effectively.
aboutVision: Through innovative approaches and creative solutions, we produce high-quality institutional information materials, establish meaningful linkages with mass media, and formulate strategic marketing initiatives that accurately represent our University's values and achievements.

servicesSectionSubtitle: Comprehensive communication solutions tailored to the needs of the institution

services.title: Content Creation & Strategy
services.description: We develop compelling content strategies and create high-quality materials including brochures, newsletters, digital content, and multimedia presentations that effectively communicate the university's message to target audiences.

services.title: Media Relations & Outreach
services.description: Building and maintaining strong relationships with media outlets, managing press releases, coordinating interviews, and ensuring positive coverage of university events and achievements.

services.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media
services.description: Comprehensive digital marketing strategies including social media management, website content, online campaigns, and digital advertising to enhance the university's online presence.

services.title: Brand Management & Design
services.description: Ensuring consistent brand representation across all communication materials, developing visual identity guidelines, and creating professional designs that uphold the university's image.

services.title: Event Communication
services.description: Complete communication support for university events including promotional materials, media coverage coordination, live event documentation, and post-event reporting.

services.title: Crisis Communication
services.description: Strategic communication planning for sensitive situations, reputation management, and coordinated response strategies to maintain the university's positive image during challenging times.
